_comment: Three shipped fixes, each pinned by an input that fails when the bug comes back. ZK008 appears twice because there are two dedupe loops with the same hole: one note names its broken target in the frontmatter and again in ## Links, the other names a body-only target twice in one Links section. ZK010 and ZK006 both land on permanent/index.md, which is a note the isolation check used to skip by filename while the filename check still reported it. A fourth input, the unmarked-paragraph note behind the retired ZK024, is kept as a negative control so the file stays honest about what is no longer checked.
